label: PF Backlog 79
title: BUG: artifact output written/read with wrong encoding -> mojibake
body: Observed: products/ProductForge-Dashboard/artifacts/0a/discovery-output.md (1777 bytes) contains mojibake (garbled non-ASCII), i.e. UTF-8 bytes decoded/encoded under cp1252 (or vice versa) somewhere on the write or read path. Audit and force utf-8 with errors='replace' consistency for: LLM response -> artifact write (core/orchestrator/agent_runner.py, pipeline_executor artifact writers) and artifact read-back (context loading, artifact_store). Also validate the artifact is decodable text before marking a stage complete.
